summary: Modal for Startups grants a one-time award of free GPU/platform credits ('thousands' per the program page, not itemized) plus engineering/GTM support and a founder community. Eligibility: new Modal customers; Seed–Series A tier requires VC funding from Modal's partner network or >$1M raised from any fund; a Scaling/Series B+ tier exists for >$30M raised / post-Series B with a partner-network VC. A payment method is required; credits are a one-time grant per tier.
claim_steps: Apply at modal.com/startups (new Modal customers only).
Seed–Series A: VC funding from Modal's partner network, or >$1M raised from any fund.
On acceptance, the one-time credit grant lands on your account; add a payment method as required.

social_proof.title: Modal for Startups
social_proof.text: Apply to get free credits, technical support, and join a growing community. Unlock thousands of free GPU credits to supercharge your startup. Credits are a one-time grant and you may not reapply once you have received credits in a given tier.
